name: menu
title: The main menu
caption: Continue where you stopped, your audiobooks, your music, speakers, settings, help.

name: menu-more
title: The rest of the menu
caption: Scroll down for Listen on, Settings, Status and Help.

name: now-playing
title: Now playing
caption: The cover, the title, who is singing, and where it is playing. Turn the wheel for volume.

name: in-progress
title: In progress
caption: Books you have started, with how far through each one you are.

name: book-now-playing
title: An audiobook
caption: An audiobook shows its chapter. Press play, and it carries on from where you stopped.

name: authors
title: Audiobooks by author
caption: Your audiobooks, grouped by author.

name: books
title: One author's books
caption: Each book shows its length and whether it is saved on the iPod to play offline.

name: book-page
title: A book
caption: Play it, remove the download, jump to a chapter, or choose where it plays.

name: chapters
title: Chapters
caption: Every chapter, with the one you are in marked.

name: music
title: Music
caption: Shuffle everything, search, favourites, new songs, artists and more.

name: music-more
title: More ways into your music
caption: Artists, genres, albums and playlists.

name: favourites
title: Favourites
caption: Hold the middle button on a song to add it here. Hold it again to take it off.

name: new-songs
title: New songs
caption: Songs added in the last month, newest first.

name: artists
title: Artists
caption: Every artist in your music.

name: artist
title: An artist
caption: Artist, album, song: the albums are a row of covers, with All songs first. Turn the wheel to move along them.

name: artist-songs
title: All of an artist's songs
caption: Choose All songs, then Shuffle to hear everything by them in a surprise order.

name: album-tracks
title: An album
caption: Choose an album to see its songs, and Shuffle to mix just that album.

name: search
title: Search
caption: Spell a song, album or artist with the wheel; it looks on the iPod and in Apple Music.

name: voice-listening
title: Listening
caption: Hold the middle button and say what you want. It pauses the music, and the wave moves as you speak.

name: voice-thinking
title: Working out what you said
caption: Let go and it works out the words, on the iPod itself or through Home Assistant.

name: voice-results
title: What it found
caption: Songs on the iPod come first; below them, songs it can stream if it is on Wi-Fi.

name: listen-on
title: Listen on
caption: Move what you are listening to to any speaker in the house, and back, from where you stopped.

name: settings
title: Settings
caption: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth headphones, arm for gifting, Find My, brightness, and more as you scroll.

name: settings-more
title: More settings
caption: Hold after, Unlock, Volume limit and a few others ask for the grown-up code when you select them.

name: wifi
title: Wi-Fi
caption: Pick a network and type its password with the wheel. Joining needs no code; forgetting one does.

name: bluetooth
title: Bluetooth headphones
caption: Pair headphones and the sound moves to them.

name: status
title: Status
caption: Whether it is connected, and what is still to sync.

name: help
title: Help
caption: The last row of the menu: a video that explains the iPod, in chapters.

name: help-video
title: The Help video
caption: It plays chapter after chapter; the wheel or Next and Previous jump between them, the middle button pauses.

name: hold
title: On hold
caption: Like the hold switch on an iPod: press the same button three times quickly to wake it up. Whose iPod it is, and who to call, show here.

name: bedtime-dark
title: Bedtime colours
caption: In the bedtime window the screen goes dark, like Night Shift.

name: bedtime-lock
title: Bedtime
caption: When tonight's listening is used up, it says goodnight. Only a grown-up's code (or Wi-Fi settings) works.

name: ha-device-top
title: The player in Home Assistant
caption: Its own device page: battery, whether bedtime is locked, minutes left, what it is playing and where, and a Find it button.

name: ha-device-config
title: Every setting, in Home Assistant
caption: Bedtime window and allowance, click sound, names, Find My, hold time, the 'if found' contact and more. Change one and the player has it within about 30 seconds.

name: ha-device-config-more
title: More settings
caption: Speakers counted elsewhere, unlock speed, voice on the iPod only, volume limit, wheel click and direction.
